param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$CorePath,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$AppRoot
)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $CorePath)){exit 0}
$src=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($CorePath,[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)

function Replace-Literal([string]$Old,[string]$New){
    if($script:src.Contains($Old)){$script:src=$script:src.Replace($Old,$New)}
}
function Replace-Regex([string]$Pattern,[string]$Replacement){
    $script:src=[regex]::Replace($script:src,$Pattern,$Replacement,[System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Multiline)
}

# Install the chosen compact open-book icon before the main UI is created.
try{[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $AppRoot 'TheFiles.png'),[Convert]::FromBase64String(''))}catch{}
try{[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $AppRoot 'TheFiles.ico'),[Convert]::FromBase64String('
